top_signals.title: Japan’s nursery school waiting lists grow for first time in nine years
top_signals.summary: The number of children on nursery school waiting lists in the nation as of April 1 rose by 181 from a year earlier to 2,435, up for the first time in nine years due largely to a sharp increase in Tokyo, the Children and Families Agency said Friday.
